name: gis-ai-go
description: Governed geospatial knowledge and action for people, systems and AI agents

scripts.build: pnpm run build:okf && pnpm --recursive --if-present run build
scripts.test:typescript: pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/contracts run test && pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/evidence run test && pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/authority-context run test && pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/policy-client run test && pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/provider-adapter-sdk run test && pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/tool-registry run test && pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/mcp-gateway run test
scripts.test:interoperability: pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/mcp-gateway run prepare:test && pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/mcp-gateway run build && pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/tool-registry run build && node --test tests/interoperability/test_qual_206_chatgpt_tunnel_exact_five_harness.mjs && node --test tests/interoperability/test_qual_206_harness.mjs tests/interoperability/test_qual_206_local_demo.mjs tests/interoperability/test_qual_206_chatgpt_tunnel_exact_five_observer.mjs apps/mcp-gateway/dist/test/qual-206-host-015.test.js && node scripts/qual_206_local_evaluations.mjs --check
scripts.test:demo-local: pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/mcp-gateway run prepare:test && pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/mcp-gateway run build && node --test tests/interoperability/test_qual_206_local_demo.mjs
scripts.demo:local: pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/mcp-gateway run prepare:test && pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/mcp-gateway run build && node scripts/qual_206_local_demo.mjs
scripts.test:qual-206-local-evaluations: pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/mcp-gateway run prepare:test && pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/mcp-gateway run build && pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/tool-registry run build && node scripts/qual_206_local_evaluations.mjs --check && uv run --locked --cache-dir .uv-cache python -m unittest tests.contract.test_qual_206_local_evaluation_receipts
scripts.generate:qual-206-local-evaluations: pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/mcp-gateway run prepare:test && pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/mcp-gateway run build && pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/tool-registry run build && node scripts/qual_206_local_evaluations.mjs --write && uv run --locked --cache-dir .uv-cache python -m unittest tests.contract.test_qual_206_local_evaluation_receipts
scripts.test:browser: pnpm run build:explorer && pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/public-explorer run test:browser
scripts.test:python: uv run --locked --cache-dir .uv-cache python -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_*.py' && uv run --locked --cache-dir .uv-cache python -m unittest discover -s services/geo-execution/tests -p 'test_*.py'
scripts.package:gateway-image: uv run --locked --cache-dir .uv-cache python scripts/package_gateway_oci.py --output-dir artifacts/gateway --platform linux/amd64
scripts.verify:gateway-image: uv run --locked --cache-dir .uv-cache python scripts/verify_gateway_oci.py --archive artifacts/gateway/gateway-image.oci.tar --checksum artifacts/gateway/gateway-image.oci.tar.sha256 --receipt artifacts/gateway/image-receipt.json --context-manifest artifacts/gateway/build-context.sha256
scripts.sbom:gateway-image: uv run --locked --cache-dir .uv-cache python scripts/generate_gateway_image_sbom.py --archive artifacts/gateway/gateway-image.oci.tar --receipt artifacts/gateway/image-receipt.json --output artifacts/gateway/gateway-image.sbom.cdx.json
scripts.test:gateway-container: uv run --locked --cache-dir .uv-cache python scripts/check_gateway_container.py --archive artifacts/gateway/gateway-image.oci.tar --receipt artifacts/gateway/image-receipt.json
scripts.check:gateway-image: uv run --locked --cache-dir .uv-cache python scripts/run_gateway_image_assurance.py --output-dir artifacts/gateway --platform linux/amd64
scripts.test: pnpm run test:typescript && pnpm run test:interoperability && pnpm run test:explorer && pnpm run test:python && pnpm run test:execution-container
scripts.build:explorer: pnpm run build:okf && pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/public-explorer run build
scripts.validate:public-read-v2: pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/policy-client run prepare:test && pnpm --filter @gis-ai-go/policy-client run build && node scripts/check_public_read_v2.mjs
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:browser && pnpm run validate:release-reproducibility && pnpm run validate:versions && pnpm run validate:public-read-v2 && pnpm run validate:contracts && pnpm run validate:links && pnpm run validate:secrets && pnpm run render:diagrams && pnpm run sbom
